GET /api/materials.name: Acrylic Sheet
GET /api/materials.unit: Per sq ft or per sheet
GET /api/materials.variants: Thickness: 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 8, 10, 12, 15, 18, 20, 25 mm (3 and 5 mm most common in signage). Colour: clear, opal, coloured, mirror, frosted. Grade: cast / extruded. Standard sheet 8 x 4 ft
GET /api/materials.thickness: Thickness: 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 8, 10, 12, 15, 18, 20, 25 mm (3 and 5 mm most common in signage)
GET /api/materials.notes: Good UV and weather resistance; can crack on strong impact. Cast grade preferred for engraving, polishing and premium letters.

GET /api/materials.name: ACP (Aluminium Composite Panel)
GET /api/materials.unit: Per sq ft or per sheet
GET /api/materials.variants: Thickness: 3, 4 mm. Sheet: 8 x 4 ft or 4 x 8 ft. Coating / look: PVDF, polyester, wooden, marble, mirror
GET /api/materials.notes: Light, flat, economical for large panels. For coastal sites prefer PVDF-coated grade.

GET /api/materials.name: SS 304
GET /api/materials.unit: Per kg
GET /api/materials.variants: Sheet 0.3-3 mm (0.8-2 mm typical for letters). Surface looks (mirror, hairline, satin, 2B, PVD colours) are in the Finishes tab
GET /api/materials.notes: Good general corrosion resistance. Coastal / high-chloride sites should use SS 316.

GET /api/materials.name: SS 316
GET /api/materials.unit: Per kg
GET /api/materials.variants: Same sheet forms as SS 304. Surface looks are in the Finishes tab
GET /api/materials.notes: Specified for coastal and high-corrosion locations.

GET /api/materials.name: Aluminium Sheet
GET /api/materials.unit: Per kg or per sq ft
GET /api/materials.variants: Sheet 0.8-1.5 mm, often powder-coated
GET /api/materials.notes: Light and corrosion-resistant but softer than stainless steel.

GET /api/materials.name: GI Sheet
GET /api/materials.unit: Per kg or per sq ft
GET /api/materials.variants: Sheet 0.5-2 mm, usually powder-coated or painted
GET /api/materials.notes: Economical, but needs good coating, especially near the coast.

GET /api/materials.name: Brass
GET /api/materials.unit: Per kg or per letter
GET /api/materials.variants: Sheet 0.8-1.5 mm
GET /api/materials.notes: Tarnishes outdoors unless lacquered or PVD-coated.

GET /api/materials.name: Copper
GET /api/materials.unit: Per kg or per letter
GET /api/materials.variants: Sheet 0.8-1.5 mm. Natural, antique, oxidised looks
GET /api/materials.notes: Develops patina outdoors unless coated.

GET /api/materials.name: Polycarbonate Sheet
GET /api/materials.unit: Per sheet or per sq ft
GET /api/materials.variants: Thickness 2-6 mm. Sheet 8 x 4 ft. Clear, opal, tinted
GET /api/materials.notes: Very impact-resistant; good for vandal-prone areas and protective lightbox faces.

GET /api/materials.name: PVC Foam Board (Sunboard)
GET /api/materials.unit: Per sq ft or per sheet
GET /api/materials.variants: Thickness 3-18 mm. Sheet 8 x 4 ft
GET /api/materials.notes: Lightweight and cheap. Not for long-term rain exposure.

GET /api/materials.name: WPC Foam Board
GET /api/materials.unit: Per sq ft or per sheet
GET /api/materials.variants: Thickness 3, 5, 8, 12, 18 mm. Sheet 8 x 4 ft
GET /api/materials.notes: More rigid and water-resistant than sunboard; semi-outdoor use.

GET /api/materials.name: Foam Board (Gator / Paper-faced)
GET /api/materials.unit: Per sq ft or per sheet
GET /api/materials.variants: Thickness 2-8 mm. Sheet 8 x 4 ft
GET /api/materials.notes: Indoor only. Light and easy to print and mount.

GET /api/materials.name: Sunpack (Corrugated PP)
GET /api/materials.alsoCalled: Sunpack; fluted PP board; corrugated plastic sheet
GET /api/materials.unit: Per sheet or per sq ft
GET /api/materials.variants: Thickness 2-5 mm. Sheet 8 x 4 ft
GET /api/materials.notes: Short-term outdoor use. Light and cheap.

GET /api/materials.name: MDF
GET /api/materials.alsoCalled: MDF board; MDF cut letter material
GET /api/materials.unit: Per sq ft or per sheet
GET /api/materials.variants: Thickness 3-18 mm. Sheet 8 x 4 ft
GET /api/materials.notes: Indoor only unless well sealed; swells with moisture.

GET /api/materials.name: Wood (Pine / Teak)

GET /api/materials.name: Flex (Backlit / Translucent)

GET /api/materials.name: Clear Vinyl

GET /api/finishes.name: Mirror (No. 8)
GET /api/finishes.worksOn: SS 304; SS 316; Brass; Aluminium Sheet; ACP (Aluminium Composite Panel)
GET /api/finishes.costEffect: None if bought pre-finished; polishing adds cost
GET /api/finishes.notes: Shows fingerprints and scratches. SS 316 preferred for coastal.

GET /api/finishes.name: Hairline / Brushed
GET /api/finishes.worksOn: SS 304; SS 316; Aluminium Sheet; Brass; ACP (Aluminium Composite Panel)
GET /api/finishes.notes: Hides fingerprints better than mirror. Popular for premium letters.

GET /api/finishes.name: Satin / Matt Metallic
GET /api/finishes.worksOn: SS 304; SS 316; Aluminium Sheet; Brass; Acrylic Sheet
GET /api/finishes.notes: Soft, premium, low-glare look.

GET /api/finishes.name: 2B (Mill Finish)
GET /api/finishes.notes: Duller industrial look; usually painted or powder-coated later.

GET /api/finishes.name: Antique
GET /api/finishes.alsoCalled: Antique brass; antique copper; old finish
GET /api/finishes.worksOn: Brass; Copper; MDF; Wood (Pine / Teak)
GET /api/finishes.notes: Mostly indoor or protected outdoor; coating needed to slow tarnish.

GET /api/finishes.name: Powder Coating
GET /api/finishes.worksOn: GI Sheet; Aluminium Sheet; SS 304; SS 316
GET /api/finishes.notes: Also used on steel structure (components list). Coastal needs proper pretreatment and a higher-build system.

GET /api/finishes.name: Liquid Paint (Enamel / PU)
GET /api/finishes.alsoCalled: Enamel paint; PU paint; spray paint
GET /api/finishes.worksOn: GI Sheet; Aluminium Sheet; ACP (Aluminium Composite Panel); PVC Foam Board (Sunboard); WPC Foam Board; MDF; Wood (Pine / Teak)
GET /api/finishes.notes: Outdoor needs primer plus exterior paint; less durable than powder coating.

GET /api/finishes.name: Anodising
GET /api/finishes.worksOn: Aluminium Sheet
GET /api/finishes.notes: Improves corrosion and wear resistance; thickness spec matters.

GET /api/finishes.name: PVD Coating
GET /api/finishes.alsoCalled: PVD gold; rose gold; black PVD; titanium
GET /api/finishes.worksOn: SS 304; SS 316; Brass; Aluminium Sheet
GET /api/finishes.notes: Good wear and corrosion resistance; quality depends on the coater.

GET /api/finishes.name: Electroplating
GET /api/finishes.worksOn: Brass; Copper
GET /api/finishes.notes: Indoor best; outdoor needs sealing and maintenance.

GET /api/finishes.name: Clear Coat / Lacquer
GET /api/finishes.worksOn: Brass; Copper; Wood (Pine / Teak); MDF; Acrylic Sheet
GET /api/finishes.notes: Slows tarnish and improves cleanability.

GET /api/finishes.name: Anti-Graffiti Coating
GET /api/finishes.worksOn: ACP (Aluminium Composite Panel); Acrylic Sheet; GI Sheet; SS 304; SS 316
GET /api/finishes.notes: For outdoor and public areas.

GET /api/finishes.name: Anti-Corrosive Primer
GET /api/finishes.alsoCalled: Red-oxide primer; epoxy primer; zinc-rich primer
GET /api/finishes.worksOn: GI Sheet
GET /api/finishes.notes: Essential before paint or powder coat on steel. Often bundled into structure price; consider hiding from the customer view.

GET /api/finishes.name: Gloss Lamination
GET /api/finishes.worksOn: Self-Adhesive Vinyl; Flex (Normal); Flex (Star / Heavy); Canvas; PVC Foam Board (Sunboard)
GET /api/finishes.notes: Scratch and moisture protection.

GET /api/finishes.name: Matt Lamination
GET /api/finishes.worksOn: Self-Adhesive Vinyl; Flex (Normal); Flex (Star / Heavy); Canvas; PVC Foam Board (Sunboard); Wallpaper / Wall Vinyl
GET /api/finishes.notes: Premium non-glare look. Cold lamination is treated as a method of this, not a separate finish.

GET /api/finishes.name: UV Coating / Lamination
GET /api/finishes.worksOn: Self-Adhesive Vinyl; Acrylic Sheet; ACP (Aluminium Composite Panel); PVC Foam Board (Sunboard)
GET /api/finishes.notes: Outdoor only with a suitable UV-cured system.

GET /api/finishes.name: Anti-Slip Laminate
GET /api/finishes.worksOn: Floor Vinyl
GET /api/finishes.notes: From the product research (floor graphics).

GET /api/finishes.name: Polished Edge
GET /api/finishes.worksOn: Acrylic Sheet
GET /api/finishes.notes: Improves clarity of transparent edges.

GET /api/finishes.name: Bevelled Edge
GET /api/finishes.worksOn: Acrylic Sheet; ACP (Aluminium Composite Panel)
GET /api/finishes.notes: Premium look on thick acrylic.

GET /api/finishes.name: Edge Banding
GET /api/finishes.worksOn: MDF; WPC Foam Board; PVC Foam Board (Sunboard); Wood (Pine / Teak)
GET /api/finishes.notes: Protects edges from moisture.

GET /api/finishes.name: Hemming & Eyelets
GET /api/finishes.worksOn: Flex (Normal); Flex (Star / Heavy); Flex (Blackout); Polyester Fabric
GET /api/finishes.notes: ADDED from product add-ons (Flex Banner).

GET /api/finishes.name: Rod Pocket
GET /api/finishes.worksOn: Flex (Normal); Flex (Star / Heavy); Polyester Fabric
GET /api/finishes.notes: ADDED from product add-ons (Flex Banner).

GET /api/finishes.name: Photoluminescent (Glow-in-Dark)
GET /api/finishes.worksOn: Self-Adhesive Vinyl; ACP (Aluminium Composite Panel); Aluminium Sheet
GET /api/finishes.notes: Mentioned as an add-on for safety signs.
